metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a standard-library-only Cargo project in [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with its CLI and BibTeX/BST interpreter in [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It reads `.bib`, `.bst`, cite-list or `.aux` inputs, writes the bibliography or error JSON, and supports the structured log. The four reference styles ran successfully on a sample entry, and `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` succeeds.

This is not yet byte-for-byte compatible with historic BibTeX for every input. Some edge cases in name parsing, LaTeX character handling, warnings, and error locations remain approximate, so identical PDFs across arbitrary existing workflows are not guaranteed.
